name: F-Sol-Standard
use_when: Hard design, evidence cross-checking. Mid tier is not enough but max reasoning is unnecessary

name: F-Sol-Deep
use_when: Conflicting constraints, hard root-cause analysis, final review where failure is costly
avoid_when: Repeated retries of the same task, time-sensitive simple work

name: F-Sonnet-Code
use_when: Multi-file implementation, refactoring, code review. Use after a smaller model fails

name: F-Sonnet-Debug
use_when: Hard-to-reproduce bugs, complex code paths, design flaw analysis

name: M-Terra-Quick
use_when: Code exploration and general research with clear conditions, small implementations

name: M-Terra-Balanced
use_when: General multi-step implementation, combined doc and code analysis
avoid_when: Simple classification, final verdicts on top-difficulty tasks

name: M-Terra-Deep
use_when: Many constraints, failure-cause analysis. Last step before escalating to Frontier

name: M-DeepSeekPro-Plain
use_when: Code writing and format conversion from clear requirements. Experiment comparing a premium model in non-reasoning mode
avoid_when: Complex design, hard problems with reasoning off

name: M-DeepSeekPro-Reason
use_when: Deep code analysis and implementation, logic review of long documents under cost limits
avoid_when: Extraction, bulk classification. Never set medium/low on this model

name: M-Haiku-Quick
use_when: Search digests, summaries, clear small edits with input <100K

name: M-Haiku-Balanced
use_when: Default route. General research and small implementations with input <100K. For long input pick another route
avoid_when: Unconditional assignment at >=100K, final high-risk judgment

name: M-Qwen-Lite
use_when: Simple digests of long material, extraction including vision. Reasoning explicitly off because effort choices are undisclosed

name: L-GLM-Extract
use_when: Narrow extraction, classification, format conversion, simple edits. Parent verifies results
avoid_when: Arbitrary none/medium settings, important unverified changes

name: Free-Nemotron-Visual
use_when: Free image/text extraction experiments. Reasoning explicitly off. No paid fallback
avoid_when: Deadline-sensitive work, personal data, high-risk judgment

name: MM-MiMo-Inspect
use_when: Simple screen, chart, and image content extraction. Reasoning off because effort levels are undisclosed
avoid_when: Deep visual reasoning, assuming direct audio/video input

name: MM-Gemini-Inspect
use_when: Complex charts, documents, screens that a cheap vision model missed
avoid_when: Bulk simple OCR, composite diagrams needing advanced reasoning

name: MM-Gemini-Reason
use_when: Relational reasoning across several diagrams/images, verifying visual contradictions
avoid_when: Simple image description, long unbounded-cost analysis
